Dear Mufti Saahab, May Allah(SWT) bless you with the best for the work you are doing. Few days ago a very pious person passed away in our town. He was not a Aalim or Haafeez but a Daaiee who was involved very much in the work of Daawaah. I wasn't there in my town during that time neither was I close to this person during his hayaat but, use to see him often while going and coming from prayers. Coming to the point. I with my family and my brother-in-law were discussing about this person after which we went to sleep. I dreamt about the person who passed away that "It is a time for prayers (Don't remember which prayer but, I feel Magrib) and this person is asking me to lead the prayers and upon his saying I led the prayers and I started reciting aayaahs (Qiraat) and I remember that I was stopping after each aayaah and was very slow in recitation (Don't remember which aayaahs). This person whom I am talking about, in the state of Salaah started reading the Aayaahs louder and little faster and I taught he is prompting me and even I started reciting it fast. Please interpret this dream of mine (Jazaakumullah). 1529 views Q. Asalamu 'alaikum, Firstly, jazak Allah for all of the questions you have answered for me. I want to remove the thought of this dream that I had a few weeks ago. At sunrise time, I went to sleep and I had this dream- before I went to sleep, I think I made du'a to Allah and said the shahadah before sleeping. I also think I had started writing a hamd (poem) and the night before I had finished, al hamdu lillah, a hamd on Asma ul husna. So I dreamt of 4 particular things. I don't know the order, but I remember seeing a lecturer talk about something to do with Islam, then all of the sudden I looked out of the window to see a beautiful scene of snow in my garden with the orangy-red night sky. Then I remember being on my prayer mat, facing the qiblah and making du'aa unto Allah. I remember supplicating Ya Mu'min (WAllahu 'alam) and I then saw a tree next to me (it was black and I think it had no leaves), it seemed like it was doing ruku' (WAllahu 'alam) and coming towards me, I kept on moving my head away and was still doing the du'aa. I woke up still mumbling the du'a. What could this mean? Jazak Allahu Khair for your continued patience. Is it true and please clarify. Question: Some people say roohanis and jins and shaitan catches some people and because of this they become mad. Is it true and please clarify. Answer ID: 7249 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 857/857=M/1429) The wicked jinns and satans can overcome a person, but this is not the case with the souls ( rooh ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
